Name: Hedge Knight
Notes: Shield-wall type - Guarded's own stand-still Bad Luck bonus plus Durable's Protected regen make it a slow, reliable damage-soak: only 1 attack a turn, but consistently hard to crack rather than a burst threat. Drafted alongside 4 other Level 1 archetypes specifically to mix up Fighting Styles (not every enemy on Flurry) - see design/enemy_sim/README.md and combat_sim.py's own docstring. Built with enemy_builder_pcstyle.py's real-PC-formula construction - Defense = 8 + Skill Total (design/ENEMY_ENCOUNTER_DESIGN.md's own validated poor/secondary/primary table, the designer's spreadsheet baseline), Damage = a weapon-style base + governing Stat, Resist = Essence alone (no longer sharing a number with Damage) - see that file's own module docstring for the full derivation. ParryTier/DodgeTier/BodilyTier/MentalTier/AttackTier (this row) replace the old Role/PrimaryDef/SecondaryDef/DamageBonus/AccuracyBonus/DefenseBonus columns for this row (left blank - unused by this construction method). HealthBonus=2 (Health 12 at Level 1, up from the real Baseline-party's own 10) is the one active retune knob, landed on after re-checking the whole calibration against the real drafted party (Hilde/Browndog/Carrick/Sable, not the smoothed generic one) and the party's own base targeting strategy (focus fire on whoever's hurt worst, then whichever enemy the whole party's collectively closest to - tactics.target_focus_wounded) once Harried (glossary.md - -1 Dodge/Parry per stack, gained by anyone who defends with Parry or Dodge, cleared at their own turn end) and both of those landed this same session. With this row's own actual Abilities (kept as-is, not the Powerful Weapon/Spell standin used to sweep the retune itself): win~99%, ~5.6 rounds (sd~1.6 - noticeably tighter than any earlier candidate this session), ~72% party Health remaining on a win - see design/enemy_sim/README.md's own entry for the full sweep and why Powerful Weapon/Spell reads as the reference point to eventually rebalance Durable/Strike (Vulnerable)/Poison (Bleeding) against, not a change to what actually ships yet. 2026-09-30: Heavy Armor is Level 3+ only for enemies now (designer), so Medium here, traded for 2 Health.

Name: Bog Skirmisher
Notes: New Kiting archetype - none of the original 4 Mixed-Style enemies (Hedge Knight/Marsh Archer/Skulking Footpad/Fen Warden) or Bog Caster ever retreat, so Parting Shot (T076) had nothing to trigger against; a real skirmisher who backs off after shooting. Ranged Weapon (Physical, distinct from Fen Warden's Melee Spell and Bog Caster's Ranged Spell), Aimed Shot rather than Guarded specifically because Kiting always spends its one move action retreating (tactics.move_kite) - Guarded's stand-still Bad Luck bonus would never trigger on a unit that always moves, so pairing Kiting with Guarded would waste half the Fighting Style. HealthBonus=0 (not the other four's +2) is a deliberate identity choice, not an oversight - this archetype's survivability is supposed to come from staying out of reach, not from raw Health, so it should die fast once actually caught (which Parting Shot and any other disengage-punishing effect is the whole point of). Built with enemy_builder_pcstyle.py's real-PC-formula construction, same as its four siblings - see Fen Warden's own Notes for the shared derivation. NOT calibrated to the same rigor as the other four (no multi-session Powerful Weapon/Spell standin sweep) - a quick 4x-clone check against the real drafted party (Hilde/Browndog/Carrick/Sable, movement=True) landed at win=100%, ~5.0 rounds, ~86% party Health on a win, well short of the other four's ~72% - Kiting alone doesn't hold up to a focused melee-heavy party in this simulator's bounded 20x20 arena (it gets cornered and caught quickly, then dies fast with HealthBonus=0), so a lone Kiter reads as considerably weaker than its stand-and-fight siblings at the same nominal Level. Good enough as a first cut to give Parting Shot and Kiting-targeting AI (tactics.target_kiter) something real to interact with; worth a fuller retune pass (more Health, or leaning harder into the Powerful Weapon/Strike (Vulnerable) bite) before treating it as validated content or folding it into MIXED_ROSTER's own default mix.
